slides.en: Your gym is visible to other gyms’ members.
A FitFlex member holds one pass for many gyms. When they travel or move, they pick from the network.
They find you by area, tier and what members said. Not by who shouted loudest on Instagram.
A verified badge after KYC, a profile-complete badge for the rest. Members see it before they come.
Every visitor checks in by QR; every visit is on your dashboard.
